}}'''Mistress Nalhera''' is the innkeeper of [[The Crown of Maredo]] in [[Far Madding]]. She is slim and gray-haired.
==History==
She talks with [[Min]], [[Nynaeve]] and [[Alivia]] in the Women's Room of her inn when Rand comes to get Min. 
She tells Min that Rand would not always be so sulky if she switched him every morning.
